title: (No AI) Character.AI files for bankruptcy
author: Robert Hart
content:
![](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/10/STK278_character_ai_B.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Character.AI, one of the first breakout startups of the generative AI boom, has filed for bankruptcy and is selling some of its assets to Disney. The company, which builds various online bots for users to chat or roleplay with, has faced mounting scrutiny and [lawsuits](https://www.theverge.com/news/858102/characterai-google-teen-suicide-settlement) over the [safety](https://www.theverge.com/report/841610/ai-chatbot-suicide-safety-failure) of its [chatbots](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1009463/character-ai-chats-encouraging-self-harm-detailed-in-unredacted-kentucky-lawsuit), but has continued [releasing](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/951461/character-ai-is-adding-new-tools-for-chatbot-creators) updates and products in recent months.

In a [press release](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261012656385/en/Character.ai-Initiates-Voluntary-Chapter-11-Proceeding-to-Facilitate-Value-Maximizing-Sale-Process) and [blog post](https://blog.character.ai/an-update-on-character-ai/) published Monday, Character said it had filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection in the US to facilitate the sale of the company and its assets. "Over the past year, we've taken meaningful steps to sustain and improve our business amid signific …

title: (No AI) Meta has some Wonder Full new AI models
author: Robert Hart
content:
![](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/10/STKB394_MUSE_AI_CVIRGINIA_D.png?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Meta is making up for lost time in the AI race. After [launching Muse Spark](https://www.theverge.com/tech/908769/meta-muse-spark-ai-model-launch-rollout), the first model from its [revamped](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/703929/meta-openai-anthropic-superintelligence-lab-ai-poaching-money) Superintelligence Labs division, and [buzzy AI agent Muse](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/991216/meta-bets-on-ai-agent-muse-to-catch-up-in-ai-race), it's now [launching](https://research.meta.ai/blog/introducing-muse-wonder) two new models it claims can go toe-to-toe with the industry's best.

The new models, Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, are available for Muse Code subscribers starting today. Wonder can also be accessed through the Meta Model API, Meta said.

Meta says it eventually plans to power its Muse AI agent with Wonder, starting with subscribers, and will develop specialized models it "can bring to everyone using Muse." It hasn't shared specifics or provided a tim …
